messages.subject: Shiny app with choropleth
parts:
Hi,

I want to build a shiny app containing a choropleth which shows frequency of names during years

My dataset is:

Name Region Frequency Year

A        X              10           1990
B        Y              20           1991

I have a shapefile which contains regions as polygons and regionnames.
I converted in GeoJSON and I can easily read and plot it in R
How to connect my dataframe with this map and get some control of years using slider?
Please help

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app with choropleth
parts:
You don't want to convert to GeoJSON; instead, you want to use the sp package to create a SpatialPolygonsDataFrame, that joins together the polygon geometry with the data. SpatialPolygonsDataFrame makes it easy to filter the polygons based on year.

So imagine you formed the SpatialPolygonsDataFrame and called it `spdf`:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

  # Create a continuous color palette that maps spdf$Frequency to the
  # ColorBrewer2.org palette "RdYlBu"
  pal <- colorNumeric("RdYlBu", range(spdf$Frequency))

  # This reactive will filter the spdf by year
  spdfYear <- reactive({
    spdf[spdf$Year == input$year,]
  })

  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet(spdfYear()) %>% addPolygons(color = ~pal(Frequency))
})
